notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.5 (Sep 11, 2025)
notes.notes: This minor update fixes the problem reported by some player that the Minimalist Achievement wouldn't trigger even when the conditions were met.

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.4 (Apr 10, 2025)
notes.notes:
This minor release fixes bugs and implements suggestions that were reported by Zirquitz's players, mainly the following:
[list]
[*] The tutorial no longer applies weird video settings, should play nicely now on multi-monitor setups
[*] There is now a BACK button (also ESC key) on the challenge selection page to go back to the title screen
[*] Though some of the nodes are derived by "Control" (not 2DNode) and therefore do not resize with the game window, they are now much friendlier to hi-res (2K and 4K) setups
[*] Some fine tuning to the challenge difficulties has been applied, to make challenges slightly more approachable
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.3 (Apr 5, 2025)
notes.notes:
This minor update includes:
[list]
[*] Various performance improvements, most of which obtained by reducing the CPU usage on lower-end processors
[*] A few UX enhancements for players with hi-DPI monitors
[*] An important fix to 3 "gift nodes" the player receives during the tutorial 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 update release notes
notes.notes:
This minor update addresses some of the feedback from early adopters, namely:
[list]
[*] improves overall performance and CPU usage
[*] fixes a crash-on-start condition on systems with multiple Steam "runtime" instances
[/list]
